info.title: GnuJango API
info.description: Gnuboard5-compatible community, shop, and member API. Administration is the Django admin at /admin/.

get.description:
OpenApi3 schema for this API. Format can be selected via content negotiation.

- YAML: application/vnd.oai.openapi
- JSON: application/vnd.oai.openapi+json
Issue a CSRF cookie and a masked token for browser API mutations.

post.description:
email_certify.php: the mailed link certifies the address once, within cf_email_certify_minutes.
POST only: the link opens the /email-certify page, which posts once it is on screen, so a mail
scanner prefetching the link certifies nothing.

register_email_update.php: a member who cannot log in yet asks for a new certify link. The login
is refused to them, so they prove who they are with the id and password the login screen took.

POST /auth/sessions/revoke {token_id}: kept for older clients; DELETE /auth/sessions/<id> is the
resource form of the same action.

get.description: Gnuboard5 download.php: download level, download points once per post, download count.
Posts per category for a board list's category chips; counts is null with a reason when skipped.

search.php: matches grouped by board. Hits carry no body — only a preview that follows the
board list excerpt rules (read level, secret, read points), as the reference API does — title
matches come first, and `page` walks one board's matches (with bo_table).

post.description:
On-demand recovery when a customer reopens the NICEPAY result page.

This only calls the transaction lookup for old approving/uncertain attempts. It never calls
the approval API again, so a reopened page cannot create a second charge.

무통장입금: the customer picks one of the shop's accounts and names the depositor. The request
then waits for the shop to confirm the deposit (admin action).

Kept for older clients: it answers where the checkout is (the legacy personalpayform.php
address, which redirects to the Next.js pay page).

BoardPostListItem.description: The keys every ``_post_payload`` row has (list rows and the detail).

BoardPostsCursorMeta.description: ``?cursor=`` mode (``_cursor_posts_response``): no totals, only where to continue.

BoardPostsPageMeta.description:
``_paginate_board_posts``: PageMeta, its aliases and the notice counts.

``total`` counts notices and regular posts; ``last_page`` counts regular posts only, since
notices are shown above each page rather than taking rows of it.

PageMeta.description: Numbered-page metadata of the list endpoints (shop_common / v1_board).

PostComment.description: ``_comment_payload``: a secret comment the viewer may not read carries a placeholder text.

PostDetail.description: The keys every ``_post_payload`` row has (list rows and the detail).

ShopAiReviewSummary.description: The chat model's plain-text summary of a product's published reviews.

ShopCart.description:
``shop_cart.cart_payload``: the lines (``?ct_ids=`` selects some, 바로구매 lines included)
and their totals; every amount is 0 for an empty cart.

ShopCartLine.description:
``shop_cart.cart_item_payload``. A line whose product was deleted still renders, with the
stored name (or the it_id) and fallback shipping / stock values.

ShopCategoryDetail.description:
``GET /shop/categories/{ca_id}``: the category, its direct sub-categories and a page of
its tree's products; ``meta`` repeats the envelope's page meta.

ShopCategoryTree.description: A top-level category of ``GET /shop/categories`` with its direct sub-categories.

ShopOrderCashReceipt.description: ``shop.cash_receipts.customer_payload``: whether the customer may request a cash receipt.

ShopOrderDetail.description: ``order_payload(order, detail=True)``: the list shape plus the lines and the cash receipt.

ShopProduct.description: ``v1_shop.product_payload`` as product lists, cards and the detail's neighbours show it.

ShopProductDetail.description: ``product_payload(..., detail=True)``: the list shape plus the neighbours and related items.

ShopProductOption.description:
A ``ShopProduct.options`` row (``shop.product_options``): 선택옵션 (io_type 0) or 추가옵션 (1).

The stored row is passed through as saved; only ``io_type`` is coerced to an int, and rows of
any other type are dropped.

ShopReturnCreate.description: The body of ``POST /api/v1/shop/orders/{od_id}/returns`` (a guest also sends ``uid``).

ShopReturnOrderLine.description: One order line and whether it may be asked for now.

ShopReturnRequest.description: ``returns.request_payload``: one request; times are ISO strings or "".
